reviews.finding: Yuanwu supplies a changing subject and asks where that intent lands; Linji asks where the monk thinks Linji's probe lands. The headword contributes only productive interrogative grammar, while each case supplies a new disputed referent. It is never raised or adjudicated as a lexical object.

The exit closes or challenges each interview, but the full verb-object-conjunction string is not spoken as an answer, quoted, glossed, capped, or made the object of later appraisal. Dramatic relevance does not make compositional stage direction a reusable lexical unit; admitting it would reproduce the rejected 打一拂子 boundary error.
